pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Large polygonal dark regions on the neck and upper flank with relatively smooth, well-defined pixel-level edges. Patch geometry transitions to smaller, more rounded and fragmented shapes toward the ventral line and lower limbs.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous network of light pathways forming a topological graph with predominantly tri-radiate and quadri-radiate junction nodes. Pathway thickness is relatively uniform across the mid-flank, approximately 10-15 pixels wide at this resolution.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: The mane along the upper neck exhibits a jagged, high-frequency 1D silhouette with low-amplitude hair tuft projections against the background.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A prominent horizontal linear mark is visible on the upper shoulder region, cutting through the pigment of at least two dark patches, indicative of a healed scar.
